TITLE: SOILDGRIDS Absolute Depth to Bedrock
DESCRIPTION: Absolute depth to bedrock (in cm) predicted using the global compilation of soil ground observations. Accuracy assessement of the maps is availble in Hengl et at. (2017) DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0169748. Data provided as GeoTIFFs with internal compression (co='COMPRESS=DEFLATE'). Measurement units: cm.
AUTHOR: Tom Hengl
CITATION: Hengl T, Mendes De Jesus J, Heuvelink GBM, et al (2017) SoilGrids250m: Global gridded soil information based on machine learning. PLoS ONE 12:e0169748. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0169748
